summary: Make cross-renderer localStorage writes observably committed before kit isolation audit reads

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The isolation browser test awaits the localStorage write acknowledgment on the audit target's CDP session before capturing its stale-view fixture. The isolation worker and its existing storage-clear acknowledgment are unchanged. No product behavior or protocol changes.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

recovery.detail: Browser-test ordering only; residual storage detection semantics are unchanged.
